title: German Hangover Cure Papillote
description: A German-inspired dish to help alleviate hangovers, featuring a poached egg and Canadian bacon in a flavorful papillote.
instructions: Cut a piece of parchment paper to fit a small baking dish.
Place 2 slices of Canadian bacon on the parchment paper.
Place an egg on top of the Canadian bacon.
Sprinkle garlic and spinach over the egg.
Fold the parchment paper to create a papillote.
Place the papillote in a small baking dish and bake for 12-15 minutes.
Remove the papillote from the oven and sprinkle with lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Serve the papillote with a side of watercress and Canadian bacon.
